documents.title: Conference Call with the Fund Managers, Analysts and Investors - Transcript
Presentation - Conference Call with the Fund Managers, Analysts and Investors on October 29, 2026

analysis.summary: Wheels India Limited reported financial and operational results for Q2 FY27 and H1 FY27, noting that export revenues grew by 30% YoY in Q2 FY27 and 23% YoY in H1 FY27. Management estimated the capex for FY27 to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crores. The company outlined strategic focus areas including growing exports, ramping up renewable and industrial component capacities, and optimizing working capital and costs. Wheels India Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, reporting standalone gross revenues of Rs 1,386.07 crs and a consolidated gross revenue of Rs 1,492.79 crs. Management estimated the capex for FY27 to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs.

guidance.claim: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs.
guidance.quote: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve double-digit EBITDA margins within the next one to two years.
guidance.quote: I think in the next couple of years because it also depends on how the economy is affected by this West Asia crisis, how long it lasts and all that. But yes, barring that, 2 years is probably what it should take.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates double-digit growth over the next five years.
guidance.quote: So just these segments alone, I think, will give us enough of growth opportunity where we can definitely do double-digit type of growth over success of the year. So we're looking at a 5-year period, yes, definitely, that's something that we will look at.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that current visibility is low due to the changing environment.
demand_outlook.quote: But currently, if you ask me, the visibility is about 1 month. The visibility right now is fairly low because of the continuously changing environment.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's demand is derived from the automotive, truck, tractor, and construction segments.
demand_outlook.quote: We have really a derived demand with our demand coming from the automotive, truck, tractor and construction segments.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex is towards expansion of capacity in auto steel wheels, cast alloy wheels, energy products division including large machining, hydraulic cylinders, construction & mining wheels and air suspension.
capex_expansion.quote: This capex is towards expansion of capacity in auto steel wheels, cast alloy wheels, energy products division including large machining, hydraulic cylinders, construction & mining wheels and air suspension .

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects to spend between INR 280 crores and INR 300 crores on capex in the current year.
capex_expansion.quote: And we expect in the current year, it will be between INR280 crores to INR300 crores of capex.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is increasing its aluminium wheel capacity from 42,000 per month to 80,000 by the second half of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: In aluminium wheels we currently have a capacity of about 42,000 per month. We are increasing it -- in a few months we are increasing it to 60,000 and then by half year, we'll increase it to 80,000.

margins_costs.claim: Cost optimization is a focus area with a thrust on profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Cost optimization, with a thrust on profitability

margins_costs.claim: The company has introduced a phased inventory provisioning policy to drive inventory reduction.
margins_costs.quote: It is more a onetime provisioning. It is not as if all this is bad inventory. But as and when those get converted, it will add to the profit of the company. But we want to actually drive inventory reduction within the company, and that is actually the reason why we have this aggressive inventory provision.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is the supplier for 85% to 90% of the machining requirements for its co-located windmill casting partner.
orders_capacity.quote: About -- let me say about 85% to 90% is us.

capital_allocation.claim: The company aims to fund capex predominantly through accruals and holding the debt at current levels.
capital_allocation.quote: Fund capex predominantly thro accruals and holding the debt at current levels

capital_allocation.claim: The company aims to increase its stake in Axles India to between 20% and 25% over time.
capital_allocation.quote: So that is the reason why our stake in Axles India came down. Subsequently, after COVID, we bought out our joint venture partner in Wheels India and Axles India has now also subsequently bought out the joint venture partner. So the idea was that Wheels India can get improve its stake, so we are looking at maybe something like 15%, maybe slightly higher, 20%, 25% over a period of time.

risks_headwinds.claim: The West Asia crisis is identified as a risk factor impacting fuel costs and overall economic growth.
risks_headwinds.quote: West Asia prices, of course, we are like everybody else in India, we are affected. The effect is basically -- one is fuel costs have gone up.
